attempts.summary: Configured node1’s persistent firewalld policy. SSH remains allowed from any address; TCP/9000 is accepted only from node2 (10.100.1.11) and explicitly rejected for all other IPv4/IPv6 sources. AlmaLinux 9.6 and kernel 5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6 were preserved. All nodes passed sequential restart and recovery verification.
